```yaml
name: Update NuGet Package Lock Json
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      prNumber:
        description: 'Pull Request number'
        required: false
  push:
    branches:
      - master
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/UpdateNugetPackageLockJson.yml'

jobs:
  update-lock-files:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Restore solution with --force-evaluate
        run: |
          dotnet restore SonarScanner.MSBuild.sln --force-evaluate

      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add .
          git commit -m "Update package lock files" || echo "No changes to commit"
          git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/master
```
